_note: Where each island model sits in the world: read by art/previs/render.py, art/sets/bake.py and art/sets/town_plan.py; explorer.html keeps the same numbers as constants. glb: the live model (baked with the sets); source: the untouched Meshy conversion the bake reads; scale: metres per model unit, set by eye so the buildings fit a 1.75 m person; centre: explorer [x, z] of the model's horizontal centre; yaw: degrees about the vertical, as the explorer's group rotation.y (and blender's rotation about +Z), turning the model so its north harbour or arms point north (-X). Each island stands on its lowest point at sea level.
